integrityRules: Resolve both R4 paths relative to this manifest and verify raw SHA-256 and byte counts before consuming R4 authority.
Verify the three pinned R3 predecessor artifacts and the exact backend/frontend continuation commits before applying this successor.
R4 is a delta: the combined R1/R2/R3/R4 restrictions apply and any unlisted edit invalidates the module result.
Auth OpenAPI export, A2 and People P2 remain unused until static implementation closes; each targeted command runs once and accepted suites do not rerun.
Any byte change to either R4 artifact invalidates this manifest.

consumptionGate.rule: Commit and push only the three R4 issuance artifacts first. Then verify origin/dwp-dev contains that exact commit, the control hashes are unchanged and the central checkout has no uncommitted control changes. The separately withheld draft module-result-evidence is not part of issuance and must not be committed before R4 completion.
